advancements.projectexplosive.root.title: Project: Explosive
advancements.projectexplosive.root.descr: Things are about to get loud.
item.projectexplosive.icbm.tooltip: Hold right-click to aim, left-click to mark
%1$s died of radiation sickness whilst fighting %2$s
advancements.projectexplosive.flash_blin: Look into a nuclear flash without flash goggles.
item.projectexplosive.bomb.warhead.none: Unarmed: fit a warhead to arm the bomb.
gui.projectexplosive.settings.title: Project: Explosive
gui.projectexplosive.settings.quality.to: Performance mode limits particles and disables blast and radiation effects. Your other settings are kept for Standard mode.
How many particles explosions emit. Lower values improve performance.
gui.projectexplosive.settings.texture.to: Classic uses the original particle sprite. Solid fills the smoke's pixel outlines. Applies to new particles.
gui.projectexplosive.settings.shake.tool: Camera movement during blasts and radiation sickness. Off keeps the camera steady.
gui.projectexplosive.settings.blast.tool: Screen effects during explosions. Disable if they conflict with your shader pack.
Green glow on irradiated players and creatures.
gui.projectexplosive.settings.distortion: Screen warping around the shockwave. Requires blast effects.
gui.projectexplosive.settings.reduced_fl: Darkens the screen instead of showing a white nuclear flash. Flash strength and camera shake can be adjusted separately.
gui.projectexplosive.settings.nuclear_li: Realistic orange light from the nuclear fireball: the hot core lights the terrain and casts shadows (Flash Goggles view). Off keeps only the screen flash. Requires blast effects.
Strength of blast effects and radiation glow.
gui.projectexplosive.settings.flash.tool: Nuclear flash intensity. Off removes the flash effect.
gui.projectexplosive.settings.destructio: Explosions break blocks and collapse damaged structures.
gui.projectexplosive.settings.damage.too: Explosion damage dealt to players and creatures.
gui.projectexplosive.settings.terrain.to: Turns blasted ground and vegetation into wasteland.
gui.projectexplosive.settings.craters.to: Crater depth multiplier. Zero prevents crater excavation.
gui.projectexplosive.settings.fire.toolt: Fire spreads through nearby combustible blocks.
gui.projectexplosive.settings.fire_damag: Custom fire damages players and creatures.
How fast the shockwave travels. Does not change the blast radius.
gui.projectexplosive.settings.experiment: Enables the unfinished napalm flask, flamethrower and extinguisher. Recipes update after a world reload.
gui.projectexplosive.settings.world.hint: Single-player gameplay settings. Changes apply immediately.
gui.projectexplosive.settings.world.remo: The server controls gameplay settings in multiplayer.
gui.projectexplosive.settings.audio.hint: Minecraft's master and Blocks volumes also apply.
gui.projectexplosive.settings.audio.remo: The server sets explosion volume. Use Minecraft's sound settings to adjust your local volume.
gui.projectexplosive.settings.volume.too: Volume of explosions and their distant echoes.
message.projectexplosive.airstrike_no_ta: Aim at the ground to call an airstrike.
tooltip.projectexplosive.bomb.place: Place on a block; detonate with redstone.
tooltip.projectexplosive.bomb.drop: Use away from nearby blocks to call a drop.
tooltip.projectexplosive.warhead: Fit to a matching bomb casing.
tooltip.projectexplosive.missile.target: Load coordinates with a target paper.
tooltip.projectexplosive.radiation_detec: Hold to read dose rate and absorbed dose.
tooltip.projectexplosive.flash_goggles: Protects your eyes from nuclear flashes. Darkens the surroundings while surfaces facing the fireball glow orange.
tooltip.projectexplosive.airstrike_calle: Calls five Mk 82s at the point you aim at.
message.projectexplosive.target_outside_: Target is outside the world border.
